# Calendar invitation generator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/calendar-invitation/

Create an ICS calendar file with an event title, time and location. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Enter an online meeting title, start/end time and description, then import the downloaded ICS file into a calendar.

## Limits and checks

This creates a file only. It does not invite attendees, send messages or create events in a connected calendar automatically.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
